data.body:
[P2] Establish evidence for dropping checkpoint compatibility

Rule 6 requires evidence for external assumptions or an explicit `unverified` label. The description justifies removing compatibility by asserting that the package has never been published and no release wrote the old checkpoint types, but supplies neither evidence nor an unverified label. Moving these classes changes reconstruction registry keys, so any existing old-format checkpoints would lose their specific error classes. Return to the design phase under rule 8, step 6, document the evidence or uncertainty, and agree on the compatibility policy.
